locateQuestion.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code loads data for a page of runs? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
locateQuestion.explanation: RunHistoryHandler.list calls `this.store.jobsForRuns([r.id])` once per run inside `runs.map`, so a 100-run page issues 100 pipeline_jobs queries (N+1), even though jobsForRuns takes an array and can load every run's jobs in one `ANY` query. Because they run concurrently through Promise.all, a single page request can also take up to 100 pool connections at once, starving other requests. It should call jobsForRuns(runs.map(r => r.id)) once and group the rows by runId.

choiceQuestions.prompt: A client requests limit=500. What does the response look like?
choices: Up to 500 runs, with nextCursor set when 500 were returned
An error, because limit exceeds the maximum
Up to 100 runs, and nextCursor is set when exactly 100 were returned
Up to 100 runs, and nextCursor is always null
choiceQuestions.explanation: recentRuns clamps the limit with Math.min(limit, 100), and list compares runs.length to the same Math.min(limit, 100) when setting nextCursor. No error is raised, and the cursor is not always null.

choiceQuestions.prompt: How does the cursor for the next page work?
choices: It is an offset that the next request skips
It is the smallest run id on this page, and the next query fetches ids strictly lower than it
It is the largest run id, and the next query fetches ids greater than it
choiceQuestions.explanation: Rows are ordered by id DESC, nextCursor is the last (smallest) id, and recentRuns adds `AND id < $3` for beforeId. It is keyset pagination, not an offset, and not timestamp-based.

choiceQuestions.prompt: If every job in a run still has durationMs null (the run is queued), what is slowestJob?
choices: It throws on comparison with null
choiceQuestions.explanation: summarize skips jobs with `durationMs === null`, so slowest stays null and slowestJob is null. No job is chosen by position, and the null check prevents comparing against null.
